title: ATM and Foreign Fees Credited on Advantage Claim Forms, Paystride Visa Payroll Card
content:
With a signed claim on the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Advantage plan, Paystride credits fees according to the claimed transaction.

1. If Paystride fees were charged on it (an out-of-network ATM fee, an international ATM fee or a foreign transaction fee), they count less any part of them already returned by refund or correction.
2. If it is a withdrawal at a domestic out-of-network ATM that carried no out-of-network ATM fee because it was one of its pay period's free withdrawals, the Advantage out-of-network ATM withdrawal fee of 1.95 counts for the free withdrawal it used.
3. Otherwise nothing counts.

For a claim whose provisional credit the signed claim schedule for the Advantage plan priced, and only for such a claim, the fees credited with the claim form credit are not returned again when an error is found. A fee credited within a claim form credit that the signed claim schedule for the Advantage plan prices, and only such a fee, is not corrected again. The other lost or stolen card claim schedules of the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account state their own.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical)

- *Input:* a foreign-currency purchase carrying a foreign transaction fee of 4.05, of which nothing has been returned. *Judgement:* a Paystride fee was charged on it. *Output:* 4.05.
- *Input:* the same purchase with its fee already refunded in full. *Judgement:* the fee was charged but fully returned. *Output:* 0.00.
- *Input:* a domestic out-of-network withdrawal, the second of its pay period, carrying no out-of-network ATM fee. *Judgement:* one of the plan's two free withdrawals. *Output:* 1.95.
